title: Impossible. Lucky. How?
format: Glowing stick-figure parable with narration (like psychoologie), phrase captions with active-word highlight

beats.text: First, they tell you it's impossible.
Friends laugh. Family worries. People who never tried anything tell you to be realistic.
Then you fall. And they say: told you so.
Nobody sees how many nights you get back up. Alone.
Then, one day, you make it. And suddenly, they call it luck.
A little later, the same people ask you how you did it.
Three words. Same people. The only thing that changed was you.
